CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery" (
 "originalDispatchId" UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 "replacementDispatchId" UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 "draftId" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "CreditoBorrador"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 "actorUserId" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "Usuario"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 "actorName" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim("actorName"))>0),
 "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim("reason")) BETWEEN 20 AND 500),
 "providerOutcome" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' CHECK ("providerOutcome"='UNKNOWN'),
 "providerReviewConfirmed" BOOLEAN NOT NULL CHECK ("providerReviewConfirmed"),
 "remoteOutcomeUnknownAccepted" BOOLEAN NOT NULL CHECK ("remoteOutcomeUnknownAccepted"),
 "originalFingerprint" CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
 "documentHash" CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 "sealChecksum" CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 CHECK ("originalDispatchId"<>"replacementDispatchId")
)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_recovery_immutable()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'DRAFT_ADMINISTRATIVE_AUDIT_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery_immutable"
 BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery"
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_recovery_immutable()

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery_guard"
 BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch"
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_recovery_guard()

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery_receipt"
 BEFORE INSERT ON "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatchReceipt"
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_receipt_guard()

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery_reconciliation"
 BEFORE INSERT ON "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatchReconciliation"
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_receipt_guard()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_draft_freeze()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery" permission
  JOIN "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch" replacement ON replacement."id"=permission."replacementDispatchId"
  WHERE permission."draftId"=OLD."id" AND replacement."status"='PREPARING') THEN
  -- Ordinary expiry closes the request but cannot change its frozen contract.
  IF OLD."estado"='ABIERTO' AND NEW."estado"='CERRADO'
   AND COALESCE(OLD."expiresAt",OLD."createdAt"+INTERVAL '15 days')<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
   AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'estado'-'closedAt'-'closedReason'-'updatedAt')=
       (to_jsonb(OLD)-'estado'-'closedAt'-'closedReason'-'updatedAt')
   AND NEW."payload" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD."payload" THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'updatedAt'-'currentStep') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'updatedAt'-'currentStep')
   OR NEW."currentStep" NOT IN(3,4) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'DRAFT_ADMINISTRATIVE_CONTRACT_FROZEN' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "CreditoBorrador_administrative_recovery_freeze"
 BEFORE UPDATE ON "CreditoBorrador"
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_draft_freeze()
